updates.text: Started shafranov: a real-time C++20 simulator solving the Grad–Shafranov equation for TCV’s free‑boundary tokamak plasma, evolving coil, vessel and plasma currents.
Added three daily post options—work, news, meme—support for private repos, and scheduled daily posts at 9 am Malaysia time with a backup at 10:15 MYT.
Added a fast fixed‑boundary Grad‑Shafranov solver, TCV vacuum vessel with 256 filaments, and poloidal field coils to the real‑time C++20 simulator.
Implemented health monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and an operator dashboard with weather, storm detour, and fleet map features.
Tick the market every 10 minutes from GitHub Actions.
Added a knife‑edge flight script with rotor‑aware roll controller, disturbances for robustness, and a Blender animation rendering the Gannet.

Started daily-post-bot: a Python bot that reads GitHub activity, fetches Hacker News stories, and uses a Groq model to generate LinkedIn and X posts in a user‑defined voice, then posts via GitHub Actions or manual triggers.
